title_as_printed: Coefficients of Equation 1 and Integral Arguments of Equations 2 and 3
pressure_note: not stated; isopiestic equilibrium in an evacuated desiccator (evacuated with a water aspirator) at 25 +- 0.005 C, pressure is the water vapour pressure of the solutions

value.what: molality of the pure Na2SO4 solution (M_C) in isopiestic equilibrium with the pure NaCl solution M_B (and with the mixtures)

value2.what: molality of the pure NaCl reference solution (M_B) in the same run (set)

composition.other_species: NaCl is the reference salt (M_B column); the mixed NaCl+Na2SO4 solutions of each run are not tabulated (only their derived coefficients a and b)

extra_unmapped: a, b (coefficients of R_B = 1 - a x_C - b x_C^2, fitted by the author)
M_B Phi_B (derived using the NaCl osmotic coefficient)
conversion_needs: molality as printed (mol per kg water implied by isopiestic practice; text says 'weighing dry pure salts into the cups, adding water')
notes: Each row is one set of runs; sets are fits of the isopiestic ratio over mixtures, so M_B and M_C are the end-member pure-salt isopiestic molalities. Set 13 is a combination of four runs with saturated Na2SO4 as reference (less accurate); set 21 is in contact with a solid phase and the authors say it is less reliable (M_B 3.62 and M_C 3.64 stated to 2 decimals in print). Footnote letters moved to note column.
